quotes.name: Benji Dillon
quotes.quote: I'm not sure what's behind my growing presence in Rockridge. I live here, I've been part of the community for a while, and I'm just doing my thing. I've been around long enough that people know me, I guess. I'm just trying to be a good neighbor and a good dad to Rick.

quotes.name: Darrin Davis
quotes.quote: I've seen Benji Dillon's name popping up more often around the A's, and it's clear he's gaining traction. To be honest, I'm not super close to him, but you can tell when someone's rising through the ranks. I've been around long enough to recognize the buzz. It's like when I was breaking in – everyone's curious, and you're getting more attention. I think it's great for the team to have fresh talent making waves.

quotes.name: Danny Horn
quotes.quote: To be honest, I've not really thought much about Benji Dillon's rising fame. I'm focused on my own game and helping the A's make a deep run. I've seen him around the clubhouse, he's a talented kid, but I don't know him well enough to say much about his personal story or what's behind his recent performances.

quotes.name: Travis Coles
quotes.quote: To be honest, I haven't really thought much about Benji Dillon's rising fame. I'm focused on my own game and the A's season. I know he's a teammate, but I don't really know him personally. I've seen his name in the papers, though.

claim: I'm not sure what's behind my growing presence in Rockridge. I live here, I've been part of the community for a while, and I'm just doing my thing. I've been around long enough that people know me, I guess. I'm just trying to be a good neighbor and a good dad to Rick.
